name: Mission Detail
route: No live route; stack-pushed mission detail keyed from Mission Board [13] or Home [12].
annotation: Mission Detail answers two questions in order: 'am I on track?' via the hero ProgressRing, then 'what's the whole picture?' through progressive disclosure. Hero ring + Mission title are the singular focal moment; KPI row and CIAInsightCard sit quietly below; ActionCheckCard's large tap-target checkbox replaces a separate BtnPrimary; five ExpandableList accordions stay collapsed by default below the fold.

modules.build: System standard, transparent over dark shell atmosphere (warm amber radial glow, top-center).

Transparent over atmosphere; BtnGhost [chevron-left] 44px target 'Back' | Title 'Mission' (fades in as content scrolls) | BtnGhost [pin] 'Pin to home screen' + BtnGhost [edit] 'Edit mission', 44px targets. Gains glass-pill (rgba(10,10,15,.55), blur 24px, border rgba(255,255,255,.10), r999) once content scrolls under.

SolidCard r40 hero. ProgressRing stroke 8px, track rgba(255,255,255,.08), fill #FF5E00 (glow-you breathing). Center: tabular-nums '72%' (H1 30 paper-100). Caption: ChipProvenance 'via WHOOP' (conditional — 'system calculated' for non-wearable missions). Sweep 0->72% on mount, 520ms physical ease-out.
Centered. Display 34 paper-100 'Hyrox Relay Prep' — the one hero type moment. Row: ChipDomainTag 'Fitness' + ChipDomainTag 'Mental', 16% domain-color bg, tappable -> dashboards, 44px hit-slop.

SolidCard r24, glow-you. 3 mini-stats, hairline dividers: '12' (H3 20 orange) 'Actions · you logged', '8' (H3 20 orange) 'Streak · you logged', '450' (H3 20 paper-100) 'XP · system'. Compact ChipProvenance captions preserve mobile density at 390px.

GlassCard r28 purple-tinted, glow-cia. Body 15 paper-100: 'Three tempo runs this week, each faster than the last. This is what *momentum* looks like.' (Newsreader Medium Italic on 'momentum'). Evidence: ChipProvenance 'via WHOOP · pace'. BtnGhost 'Ask CIA ->' — this card IS the chat exit, no separate persistent affordance.

SolidCard r24, glow-you. Empty circle checkbox + Body 15 paper-100 '20-min easy run - tomorrow'. Caption 12 paper-60 'tap the circle to mark done'. Entire card is the 44px tap target — large surface replaces a separate BtnPrimary.
Floating pill, fixed overlay: Today · CIA · Goals · Me, 44px targets, overlays last visible content per canon.

belowFold: Five ExpandableList accordions below the fold, all collapsed by default (spec correction: an earlier draft wireframe had pre-expanded 'All Actions'; now consistently collapsed): All Actions; Milestones (glow-done); CIA Reasoning (glow-cia, expands to IntelligenceTimeline staged trace 'checking your training log' -> 'comparing to last month'); Cross-Domain Links (glow-you, ListRow entries to linked missions/dashboards); Progress Over Time (glow-cia, TrendChart — solid orange user line, dashed purple projection, green milestone dots). SectionHeader trigger, spring collapse 200ms, chevron rotates 180deg.
Stalled state (no action in 7 days): CIAInsightCard swaps to stalled coaching copy and offers a Sheet (variant action) with four ListRow choices — a 'see options' exit, never a dead end.
trustControls: ChipProvenance on Mission Completion %: real reads 'via WHOOP' when actions sync from a wearable, or 'system calculated' for manual-log missions — provenance is conditional, never hard-coded to one source.
Low-confidence Mission Completion %: 72% at 64% opacity + 'estimated · low confidence' + purple ConfidenceMeter, shown only when wearable sync is partial.
Honest-null Mission Completion %: 'Not enough data yet - 3 more days to calibrate,' ring renders ghosted at 0%; honest-null Action count: 'No actions logged yet.'

Consent/Safety source chips for category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete wherever data appears; documented as a modal/overlay/utility surface, never an invented live route.
Sheet (variant action) — stalled-mission 'see options' surface, four ListRow choices, spring-in 250ms.
notes: Corrects three draft errors. (1) Display 34 belongs to the Mission title 'Hyrox Relay Prep' only — the spec's Focal Hierarchy calls it 'the one hero type moment'; the draft misapplied Display 34 to the ring's '72%' and demoted the title to H1 30, so both are swapped back (ring center = H1 30, title = Display 34). (2) KPIRow's XP figure (450) is recolored from purple to paper-100 — canon reserves purple strictly for CIA/AI synthesis, and XP is a system-calculated reward, not a CIA read. (3) belowFold restructured from module objects to descriptive strings per schema; GlassNavBar promoted into the main modules list since it's a persistent fixed overlay, not below-the-fold content, and the five accordions are described with their exact labels and per-accordion glow. Ring retains last cached value on Error (never resets to zero). Route header kept verbatim per spec: stack-pushed from Mission Board [13] or Home [12], no live route.
